body:
PARENA/stdlib/edge_game/traffic_router.prn: pure routing decision logic for EDGE.GAME's arcade-cabinet hardware fan-out (Windows PC hub <-> Pi + Nano via an Adafruit Feather). Corrected from a pasted AI-tutorial draft with several real PARENA syntax errors (comma-separated params, Void vs Unit, get vs get-field, == vs =) that would not have compiled. Found and named (not fixed) a real, separate compiler DX gap: zero-field defenum variants must construct as a bare symbol, not a zero-arg call form -- src/emit.c's call-form dispatch has no field_count==0 branch. 4/4 tests pass, strict -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -Werror clean. Commit 424925c.

⚓ ☃
title: EDGE.GAME traffic_router module -- real, built, tested (S584)
